text: Which NK-cell-specific genes in both the single-cell and the blood immune cell data are not secreted into the blood?
plan: Cell type category (scRNA): NK-cells / Cell type enriched AND Immune cell category (RNA): NK-cell / Immune cell enriched AND NOT Secretome annotation: Secreted to blood
understanding: The user is looking for genes that are specific to NK-cells in single-cell RNA-seq data and in blood immune cell RNA data, while excluding proteins that are secreted into blood according to secretome annotations.

trail.why: NK-cell-specific genes in the single-cell RNA-seq dataset corresponds to selecting 'NK-cells' at Level 1 and 'Cell type enriched' (defined as at least four-fold higher mRNA level compared to any other cell type) at Level 2.

trail.requirement: NK-cell-specific genes in blood immune cell data
trail.why: NK-cell specificity in the blood immune cell dataset is defined as 'Immune cell enriched' for the 'NK-cell' cell type.
The filter targets proteins categorized as 'Secreted to blood' so that they can be excluded according to the requirement.

requirements.why: This field specifies RNA specificity categories across single cell types, directly matching 'NK-cells' from single-cell data.

requirements.requirement: NK-cell-specific genes in blood immune cell data
requirements.why: This field captures RNA specificity across flow-sorted immune cell types from blood, including 'NK-cell'.
This field categorizes predicted secreted proteins by destination, specifically providing the option 'Secreted to blood', which we negate.
